description.en: Blocks rain from the sky. Slide left and right to survive as long as you can.
description.zh-TW: 方塊從天而降，左右閃避，撐得越久越好。

instructions.en: Drag or tap to move. Arrow keys work too. Every block you dodge scores a point; one hit ends the round.
instructions.zh-TW: 拖曳或點擊移動，也可以用方向鍵。每閃過一個方塊得 1 分，被打中就結束。
